title: Chapter 1484 - 608: I Accept Them All!
content:
Chapter 1484: Chapter 608: I Accept Them All!

"What is this weapon battle formation of Ning Zhuo?"

"He’s altering the formation mid-battle!"

"Under such pressure, he’s still improving the battle formation?"

The observing cultivators immediately realized this truth, and for a moment, they were all moved, their inner shock indescribable!

Flowing Gold Guest felt more and more uncomfortable as the fight went on.

His Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo was extremely suitable for him and had been feeding back to him. Just with this alone, it could rival Ning Zhuo’s various replenishment methods combined.

But no matter how strong the feedback, it couldn’t compensate for the tilt in the battle situation.

Flowing Gold Guest gradually fell into a disadvantage, under everyone’s gaze, he was caught in a front and rear attack by the Wheel Slash Formation, besieged from left and right, beaten until his skin broke and flesh tore, gradually attacking less and defending more.

"No, I absolutely cannot lose!" Flowing Gold Guest’s fighting spirit was like fire, suffering setbacks and falling into a disadvantage, but it only made him less willing to give up.

"I, a dignified Golden Core Cultivator, how can I lose to a Foundation Establishment mid-stage twice in a row?"

"Especially the second time, I possess so many treasures!"

Flowing Gold Guest was about to grind his teeth to pieces, desperately holding on.

The crowd watched in astonishment.

Flowing Gold Guest, who was so imposing before the battle started, like a fierce tiger descending a mountain, now was like a stray dog fleeing in all directions, being chased and beaten by Ning Zhuo everywhere.

Especially the cultivators from the power of Flowing Cloud Peak, upon seeing this scene, all had dark faces, or were gnashing their teeth.

They had fully armed Flowing Gold Guest, targeting various mechanical techniques of Ning Zhuo, but Ning Zhuo used the Defensive Wheel Slash Formation to make Flowing Gold Guest run wildly.

This greatly exceeded their expectations.

"Golden Stone Opening Skill can dissolve ordinary mechanical artifacts, but these Mystic Armors are integrated, unable to be dismantled."

"Can Mechanical Techniques be used this way?"

"Ning Zhuo’s level in Array Dao is immeasurable! Such means require extremely profound skill in both Mechanical Techniques and Array Formation."

"Someday I’ll also go to Xuan Armor Cave to buy some Mystic Armors and try it."

As the battle continued, the glow at Ning Zhuo’s waist dimmed gradually.

This was already the third one.

Repeated use of Five Qi Returning Essence Pills, though the medicinal power was strong, caused Ning Zhuo’s meridians to swell slightly. The Cloud Tide Replenishing Talisman burned out, turning to ash, and fell from inside his collar.

As for the Soul Absorption Box, it finally made a cracking sound, the internal mechanism overheated and exploded, the box lid flipped open, spraying a puff of blue smoke.

Ning Zhuo directly put it into the Storage Waist Belt.

The watching cultivators’ eyes lit up, feeling that the situation had changed again.

"Ning Zhuo prepared many methods to sustain the battle, but now these methods are about to be exhausted."

"The Defensive Wheel Slash Formation has opened my eyes, but this method consumes too much mana."

"Indeed. Among them are not lacking Golden Core Level Mystic Armors, and Ning Zhuo is just a mid-stage Foundation Establishment. If he were a Golden Core Level cultivator, Flowing Gold Guest would have no hope of winning at all. But the fact is, Ning Zhuo is just at Foundation Establishment!"

"He’s out of mana!"

"Flowing Gold Guest still has the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo!"

"As long as it drags on a bit longer, Ning Zhuo might not hold out."

Flowing Gold Guest naturally also perceived this.

His spirit lifted, the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo in his chest beat wildly again, the golden-red glow made his face very ferocious.

He roared in his heart: "My persistence is correct!"

At the same time, he shouted: "Ning Zhuo, you’re running out of mana! This battle will ultimately be my win!"

Ning Zhuo looked up at him, yet there was not a trace of panic in his eyes, instead, they showed a hint of regret.

"Ultimately, does it have to end?" he sighed softly.

The next moment, he activated the last magic pool completely.

Five-colored radiance flooded into the Qi Sea with a surge.

Simultaneously, the Defensive Wheel Slash Formation suddenly contracted!

Blade, sword, axe, hook, fist, shield, and Old Cold Leg Mystic Armors all returned to position, the inner and outer wheels overlapped in an instant. The originally scattered formation configuration seemed to suddenly turn into a rotating blade millstone.

The axe soldier struck first.

Flowing Gold Guest blocked with both arms, his momentum halted, the golden armor cracked again.

The sword armor borrowed the residual shock of the axe to slash obliquely, mercilessly expanding the crack at its edge.

The sword soldier, like a line of cold stars, pierced deep into the crack, and immediately a flying sword of golden blood.

The hook soldier circled behind, hooked onto Flowing Gold Guest’s shoulder armor, and pulled sharply, throwing him off balance.

Old Cold Leg kicked from below into the side of his knee, the cold force exploded, causing his stance to falter.

The fist armor and shield armor crashed from the left and right, blocking all his retreat paths.

Finally, blade, sword, axe, hook, four Golden Core Xuan Armors simultaneously performed a wheel slash!

Cold light like a ring!

Soldier shadows like the moon.

Flowing Gold Guest’s pupils suddenly shrank.

That familiar crisis, chilling to his divine soul, assaults once more.

Neck!

It’s the neck again!

He wanted to retreat, but was dragged by Thousand Weight Plunge, reversing his steps.

He wanted to erupt with golden blood, but was delayed when the sword soldier stabbed into the golden armor’s crack, the flow of golden blood stagnated for a moment.

He wanted to mobilize the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo, but as soon as his chest brightened, Old Cold Leg’s cold force rushed up from below, causing his blood and Qi to shift a half-breath slower.

A half-breath was enough.

Clang, clang, clang, clang!

Four Golden Core Level Mystic Armors alternated to slash at his neck.

This time, it wasn’t a Flaming Great Saber like the Blazing Blood Gold Slash, but from the Defensive Wheel Slash Formation.

The sword armor cut open the golden armor, the sword soldier sealed the blood path, the axe soldier shattered the Protective Golden Power, and the hook soldier misaligned the center of gravity.

Four combined forces, four strikes stacked, forcibly cutting a cold line at Flowing Gold Guest’s neck.

Puff!

Golden blood spurted.

Flowing Gold Guest’s head, once again, flew into the air.

The field fell momentarily silent.

Then, the uproar erupted like a tide!

"Cut again!"

"Ning Zhuo decapitated Flowing Gold Guest again!"

"No one expected this time it wasn’t the Fire Technique, but the battle formation! It’s the formation composed of Mystic Armors!"
